description: Slide switch, SPDT, sub-miniature, right angle (actuator at the board edge), SMD with two locating pegs, 0.3 A 6 V DC: pins A, COM, B

datasheet.revision: C&K JS Series Sub-Miniature Slide Switches catalog pages I-49 to I-60, dated 29 jun 16: p. I-52 right angle surface mount (JS102011SAQN), p. I-49 specifications

package.name: JS102011SAQN (right angle SMD slide switch)

landPattern.page: p. I-52, PCB mount - hole layout: 3 pads 1.2 x 2.50 at 2.5, their far edge 4.0 from the line of the two peg holes (dia. 0.9, 6.8 apart), so the pads' centres 2.75 from it. Origin at the middle between the peg holes

package.page: p. I-52: body 9.0 x 3.6, 3.5 high; the actuator 1.5 wide standing 2.0 out of the front, travel 2.0; pegs dia. 0.8 under the body; the terminals' tips 3.75 from the pegs

pins.name: A
pins.description: throw A (C&K: terminal 1): joined to COM in one slider position

pins.name: B
pins.description: throw B (C&K: terminal 3): joined to COM in the other slider position

notes: SPDT: COM joins A in one position and B in the other. As an on/off switch: COM to the load (a regulator's input or EN), A to the supply, B unconnected (or to GND to pull EN down when off).
Rated 0.3 A at 6 V DC: switch a regulator's enable pin or a small load, not a motor or a LiPo's full current (use a MOSFET load switch driven by the slide switch for that).
Put it at the board edge with its front (-Y, the actuator) on the edge line; the pads lie behind the body (+Y).
The two 0.9 mm holes take the housing's plastic pegs: non-plated.

pins.source: C&K JS Series Sub-Miniature Slide Switches catalog pages I-49 to I-60, dated 29 jun 16, p. I-52: JS102011SAQN drawing (terminal No. 1, body 9.0 x 3.6 x 3.5, actuator 2.0 out), PCB mount - hole layout, circuit diagram (2 = C, common); p. I-49 specifications
